name: CE_CP_SYS_TRX_INT
description: This interface table contains the system transaction.

columns.name: CP_SYS_TRX_ID
columns.description: Sequentially generated surrogate key for the system transaction interface table.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Instance of the source. Valid values are FUSION, EBS or OTHER.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source of transaction. For example, accounts receivable receipts, accounts payable payments, payrolls, external cash transactions and bank statements.

columns.name: FLOW_INDICATOR
columns.description: Flow indicator of the transaction. Valid values are Inflow or Outflow.

columns.name: RECON_STATUS
columns.description: Reconciliation Status of the transaction. Valid values are Reconciled, Unreconciled or Not Applicable.

columns.name: SOURCE_TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the system transaction.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name assigned to a bank account for identification purposes.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the bank account used by the deploying company.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank of the system transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date of the system transaction.

columns.name: VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Value date of the system transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number of the system transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the system transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount of the system transaction.

columns.name: REPORTING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount in reporting currency.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Transaction type of the system transaction.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Ledger currency code of the system transaction.

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_AMOUNT
columns.description: Ledger currency code of the system transaction.

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the bank account.

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount in bank account currency.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_REGION
columns.description: Name of the legal entity region for the transaction.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the legal entity of the system transaction.

columns.name: CASH_POOL_NAME

columns.name: PARENT_CASH_POOL_NAME
